plain: Anything using --primitive-easing-elastic, --hds-motion-expressive-easing or the --hds-anim-appear, --hds-anim-entrance and --hds-anim-spin presets now animates with a small spring overshoot instead of being dropped as invalid CSS; check those animations look right.

steps.plain: --primitive-easing-elastic is now a valid linear() spring curve with about 11% overshoot, where the old spring(300, 20, 1) value was invalid CSS and the browser dropped it, so animations using it now overshoot slightly instead of falling back to their default easing.
